     `CompactSeparableKernelPotential` constructs the explicit Hermitian
     separable kernel `K(q,r) = phi(q) * conj(phi(r))`.  Its operator is rank
     one, factors through the finite-dimensional field C, is compact, and has

     Separately, the actual pointwise discriminant multiplier is treated by

  6. Shift removal/Fredholm alternative.
     `ShiftedCompactDecomposition` proves the exact factorization

     `ExplicitDiscriminantPotential` defines the Petersson norm of the modular

  8. Closed realization and resolvent boundary (P9).
     The associated Petersson operator is densely defined, closed, and
     self-adjoint.  `BoundedPartialResolventAt` records a genuine bounded

  9. Manuscript correction and spectral dependency firewall (P10/P11).

  * No interior/cusp elliptic regularity, compact resolvent, discrete spectrum,

  * No Eisenstein normalization, scattering Plancherel theorem, half-integral

  * No global quotient q-radius or interior `|q| = 1` interface is asserted;

structure therefore remains explicit, while the inverse-Dedekind-eta
construction below supplies a concrete coherent multiplier at every integer
index.  All normalization, cocycle, nonvanishing, section algebra, and
metric-invariance consequences are proved rather than postulated separately.

namespace AutomorphicSobolev

open UpperHalfPlane

/-! ### 6.2: square-root multipliers and weight sections -/

/

`sqrtFactor` is a chosen square root of the classical denominator `c z + d`;
it is not required to be an ordinary cocycle.  Indeed, on a group containing
`-I` such a square-root cocycle is impossible.  The phase `nu` cancels its
metaplectic sign defect, and the cocycle law is imposed only on the resulting
total weight-`k/2` factor `nu γ * sqrtFactor γ z ^ (-k)`.
-/

    HalfWeightCompactCoordinateGreen.localizeLeft
        (fun z => star (euclideanRaiseGauge n f z))

        ((euclideanGaugeExponent n + 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) •

    (H : ℝ)

    (hX : ∀ q ∈
      Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ), 0) (1 / 2 : ℝ, 1),
      HasFDerivAt X (DX (curvedTileRectangleMap H q))
        (curvedTileRectangleMap H q))

    baseModularTruncationBoundaryFlux H U V =

          baseModularCircularFluxIntegrand

        (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(H - modularVertexHeight),

          realProdLift U (-(1 / 2), modularVertexHeight + s) :=

theorem euclideanRaiseGauge_sub_lowerPredGauge

declarations.signature:
theorem dx_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback
    (q : GammaTwoRightCoset) {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hf : RealSmooth f)
    (z : ℍ) :
    dx (selectedCosetUnitaryPullback q f) z =
      dx (selectedCosetConformalScaleC q) z *
          f (selectedCosetAction q z) +
        selectedCosetConformalScaleC q z *
          (selectedCosetA q z * dx f (selectedCosetAction q z) +
            selectedCosetB q z * dy f (selectedCosetAction q z)) :=

declarations.name: dy_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback
declarations.signature:
theorem dy_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback
    (q : GammaTwoRightCoset) {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hf : RealSmooth f)
    (z : ℍ) :
    dy (selectedCosetUnitaryPullback q f) z =
      dy (selectedCosetConformalScaleC q) z *
          f (selectedCosetAction q z) +
        selectedCosetConformalScaleC q z *
          (-selectedCosetB q z * dx f (selectedCosetAction q z) +
            selectedCosetA q z * dy f (selectedCosetAction q z)) :=

theorem height_mul_dy_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback
    (q : GammaTwoRightCoset) {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hf : RealSmooth f)
    (z : ℍ) :
    heightC z * dy (selectedCosetUnitaryPullback q f) z =
      (selectedCosetA q z - selectedCosetConformalScaleC q z) *
          f (selectedCosetAction q z) -
        selectedCosetB q z *
          (heightC (selectedCosetAction q z) *
            dx f (selectedCosetAction q z)) +
        selectedCosetA q z *
          (heightC (selectedCosetAction q z) *
            dy f (selectedCosetAction q z)) :=

theorem norm_height_mul_dy_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback_le

    (z : ℍ) :
    ‖heightC z * dy (selectedCosetUnitaryPullback q f) z‖ ≤
      ‖selectedCosetConformalScaleC q z‖ *
        (2 * ‖f (selectedCosetAction q z)‖ +
          ‖heightC (selectedCosetAction q z) *
            dx f (selectedCosetAction q z)‖ +
          ‖heightC (selectedCosetAction q z) *
            dy f (selectedCosetAction q z)‖) :=

declarations.name: norm_height_mul_dy_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback_le_graph
declarations.signature:
theorem norm_height_mul_dy_selectedCosetUnitaryPullback_le_graph
    (n : ℤ) (q : GammaTwoRightCoset) {f : ℍ → ℂ}

      (fun j ↦ PhysicalLocalL2.ambientTestCoreToCarrierL2 (n + 1) (v j))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝒩 (PhysicalLocalL2.orbitPeterssonEuclideanEmbedding (n + 1)
        p.1)))
    (hRaise : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun j ↦ PhysicalLocalL2.ambientTestCoreToCarrierL2 ((n + 1) + 1)
        (euclideanRaiseForwardTest (n + 1) (v j)))
      Filter.atTop

        ((n + 1) + 1) p.2.fst)))
    (hLower : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun j ↦ PhysicalLocalL2.ambientTestCoreToCarrierL2 n
        (euclideanLowerFromSuccForwardTest n (v j)))
      Filter.atTop
      (𝒩 (PhysicalLocalL2.orbitPeterssonEuclideanEmbedding n
        p.2.snd))) :
    ∃ q : ℕ →
        OrbitPeterssonHilbert (n + 1) × PhysicalJointTarget n,
      (∀ j : ℕ, q j ∈ (physicalJointFromSucc n).graph) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto q Filter.atTop (𝒩 p) :=

theorem.  This section therefore constructs the weighted weak space
independently, inside the actual three Petersson Hilbert coordinates.

At source index `n + 1`, a triple `(u, r, l)` is weakly differentiable when

* `r` satisfies the distributional raising identity against every smooth
  test at index `(n + 1) + 1`; and
* `l` satisfies the distributional lowering identity against every smooth
  test at index `n`.

The Euclidean gauge factors, half-integral multiplier, and quotient measure
are already incorporated in the three Petersson Hilbert spaces.  Thus the
two displayed identities are intrinsic quotient identities, not unweighted
ambient-plane substitutes.  Each defect is a continuous linear functional,
so their common kernel is a closed Hilbert subspace.  The smooth joint graph
maps canonically and isometrically into it.  Surjectivity of the resulting
completion map is isolated below as the exact joint Friedrichs/core-density
statement; it is not inserted as a structure field or an assumption in the
definition.
-/
